justification: The only real correspondence is a profile human figure in shallow relief accompanied by fields of repeated small units (a rosette band in A, glyph blocks in B), which is a very generic pairing. A depicts a narrative of a horse drawing a spoked-wheel chariot with a driver in a horizontal register, while B shows a single static, heavily ornamented standing figure with plumed headdress hemmed in by columns of sign-blocks — different subjects, compositions and figural conventions.
